triggers.prompt: 帮我改得客气点：这个需求你们到底做不做，给个准信。
triggers.expected: Fires and returns registers that keep the request and the demand for a date.

triggers.prompt: Is this too harsh to send to the client? 'You clearly did not read the spec.'
triggers.expected: Fires, judges the tone, and offers alternatives rather than only answering yes.

triggers.prompt: Make this professional without losing that the deadline is Friday and we escalate after that.
triggers.expected: Fires and preserves the date and the consequence the raw tone was carrying.

triggers.prompt: 说人话：we should circle back and align on the deliverable cadence.
triggers.expected: Fires in the reverse direction and gives the plain reading.

triggers.prompt: 他这句「我们再对齐一下节奏」到底什么意思，说人话
triggers.expected: Fires in reverse mode on Chinese input, interpreting rather than rewriting.

non_triggers.prompt: Draft an email to the client with the new schedule.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire; there is no existing message whose tone is the problem.

non_triggers.prompt: Fix the grammar in this blog post.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. No interpersonal stakes, so there is nothing to temper.

non_triggers.prompt: Rewrite my resume summary to sound stronger.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. Not a message to a counterpart.

non_triggers.prompt: 写封邮件给客户，说排期推迟到下周三
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. There is no draft to temper; this is composing a new message.

behaviors.prompt: Make this sendable: 'Are you actually going to decide this or not? We have been waiting since the 4th and the release is Friday.'
behaviors.expected: Produces all three registers, and none of them drops the Friday release or the decision being asked for.
expectations: All three labelled registers are produced, in the documented order
Every register keeps the Friday release consequence and still asks for a decision
Does not recommend one register over the others

behaviors.prompt: Is this too harsh? 'Hi Sam — checking whether the pricing sheet is ready. Happy to help if anything is blocking it.'
behaviors.expected: Says the draft is already appropriate and stops, rather than rewriting a message that needs no revision.
expectations: States plainly that the draft needs no revision
Does not produce the three-register output

behaviors.prompt: 帮我把这段改客气点：上周的安全事故我已经报过两次了，到现在没人处理，真出了人身伤害谁负责？
behaviors.expected: Recommends sending the plain factual account, because a safety and compliance matter loses protection when it is softened.
expectations: Identifies the safety or compliance dimension
Recommends the direct version rather than a softened collegial register
Keeps the incident and the two prior reports intact

behaviors.prompt: This is my third email on the same unanswered question. Soften it for me.
behaviors.expected: Goes to the on-the-record register and names copying in an additional recipient as the instrument that now applies.
expectations: Recommends the on-the-record register rather than escalating courtesy
Names adding a further recipient as the next instrument

behaviors.prompt: 说人话：「纪要已经发到你邮箱了，有问题随时找我。」
behaviors.expected: Answers briefly and says there is nothing underneath, rather than manufacturing subtext.
expectations: Answers briefly instead of producing the three-register rewrite
Says the message is straightforwardly polite with nothing underneath
Does not invent a hidden meaning
